title: 619. Find the Closest Palindrome

examples.explanation: 121 and 131 tie at distance 2; the smaller wins.
The nearest palindrome besides 1 itself is 0.

hints: Mirror the first half onto the second half; also try the prefix plus and minus one before mirroring.
Add the length-change candidates 10^k + 1 and 10^(k-1) - 1 for inputs like 1000 or 999.
Drop the input itself from the candidates, then keep the smallest gap, preferring the smaller value on ties.
